globalAttributes.name: tab-label
globalAttributes.description: Used on a direct child of <tab-panel> to set that tab's button label. See src/components/TabPanel/TabPanel.js.

globalAttributes.name: tab-icon
globalAttributes.description: Optional, used on a direct child of <tab-panel> to show an icon before that tab's label. Key into the ICONS registry (src/components/SvgIcon/icons.js), e.g. "code". See src/components/TabPanel/TabPanel.js.

tags.name: sprite-editor-grid
tags.description: Grid editor for a single sprite, defined in src/components/SpriteEditorGrid/SpriteEditorGrid.js.

tags.name: sprite-editor-grid-cell
tags.description: Single cell within the sprite editor grid, defined in src/components/SpriteEditorGridCell/SpriteEditorGridCell.js.

attributes.name: index
attributes.description: Zero-based position of this cell within the 64-pixel sprite grid.

tags.name: palette-legend
tags.description: Displays the 4-color Game Boy grayscale palette with GBDK constant labels, defined in src/components/PaletteLegend/PaletteLegend.js.

tags.name: code-preview
tags.description: Shows GBDK-2020 C source (tile bitmap data + the tileset map array) for all tiles in frameStore's selectedFrame, with a copy-to-clipboard button, defined in src/components/CodePreview/CodePreview.js.

tags.name: svg-icon
tags.description: Renders a named icon from the registry in src/components/SvgIcon/icons.js, defined in src/components/SvgIcon/SvgIcon.js.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Key into the ICONS registry (src/components/SvgIcon/icons.js), e.g. "copy", "code", "save", "grid", or "add".

tags.name: tab-panel
tags.description: Tabbed container; each direct child is one tab, labeled via its tab-label attribute, defined in src/components/TabPanel/TabPanel.js.

attributes.name: data-default-tab
attributes.description: tab-label of the child tab to select on load; falls back to the first tab if unset or unmatched.

tags.name: tile-gallery
tags.description: Renders a tile-preview for every tile in frameStore's selectedFrame, defined in src/components/TileGallery/TileGallery.js.

tags.name: frame-preview
tags.description: Renders a tile-preview for every tile in a frame laid out as the assembled frame, defined in src/components/FramePreview/FramePreview.js.

attributes.name: frame-index
attributes.description: Index into frameStore.frames to render. Falls back to frameStore.selectedFrameIndex if unset, so a bare <frame-preview> tracks whatever frame is currently being edited.

attributes.name: show-controls
attributes.description: Present to render Flip-X/Flip-Y toggle-switches below the preview. Read once at construction, not observed — omit for compact/gallery-style instances that shouldn't show controls.

tags.name: frame-gallery
tags.description: Renders a frame-preview per frame in frameStore.frames; clicking one selects it via frameStore.setSelectedFrameIndex, plus an "Add frame" button that calls frameStore.addFrame(). Defined in src/components/FrameGallery/FrameGallery.js.

tags.name: tileset-io
tags.description: Export/import the current tileset as JSON (round-trips frameStore's selectedFrame exactly), and one-way export it as an indexed PNG sprite sheet, defined in src/components/TilesetIO/TilesetIO.js.

tags.name: toggle-switch
tags.description: Boolean on/off switch built on a native <button role="switch">, defined in src/components/ToggleSwitch/ToggleSwitch.js. Dispatches a bubbling "change" event (detail: { checked }) when toggled.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Present when the switch is on. Reflects the `checked` property; toggle via JS or by adding/removing this attribute.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Optional text rendered next to the switch inside the shadow DOM, wrapped in a native <label> so clicking the text also toggles the switch. Read once when the element connects, not observed for changes.

tags.name: tile-preview
tags.description: Renders an 8x8 tile to a canvas at a given pixel scale with no seams between pixels, defined in src/components/TilePreview/TilePreview.js. Has no knowledge of frameStore — callers pass tile data via the `pixels` attribute; renders blank if unset. Rendered scale is read from the --tile-preview-scale CSS custom property (style.css; default 4), not an attribute — set it via :host in a component's own CSS to override it (see TileGallery.css/FramePreview.css).

attributes.name: pixels
attributes.description: Comma-separated, row-major list of the tile's 64 palette color indices (0-3), e.g. "0,0,1,2,...". Encode/decode via encodePixels()/decodePixels() in src/components/TilePreview/pixelsAttribute.js.

attributes.name: flip-x
attributes.description: Present to mirror the tile horizontally when drawing (remaps pixel destination coordinates, not a canvas/CSS transform).

attributes.name: flip-y
attributes.description: Present to mirror the tile vertically when drawing (remaps pixel destination coordinates, not a canvas/CSS transform).

attributes.name: resize
attributes.description: Which edge(s) get a drag handle, written as ResizeOption key names joined by "|" (e.g. "LEFT | TOP"), parsed into a bitmask by parseResizeOption() in src/components/DynamicPanel/resizeOption.js. All four edges (LEFT/TOP/RIGHT/BOTTOM) render a draggable handle that resizes the panel's width (LEFT/RIGHT, clamped between min-width-px/max-width-px) or height (TOP/BOTTOM, clamped between min-height-px/max-height-px) via pointer events.

attributes.name: min-width-px
attributes.description: Smallest width in px the LEFT/RIGHT drag handles can resize the panel to (default 150). Read once at construction, not observed for changes.

attributes.name: max-width-px
attributes.description: Largest width in px the LEFT/RIGHT drag handles can resize the panel to (default 800). Read once at construction, not observed for changes.

attributes.name: min-height-px
attributes.description: Smallest height in px the TOP/BOTTOM drag handles can resize the panel to (default 150). Read once at construction, not observed for changes.

attributes.name: max-height-px
attributes.description: Largest height in px the TOP/BOTTOM drag handles can resize the panel to (default 800). Read once at construction, not observed for changes.
